Если откалибровать симулятор точно, ранд: If you calibrate the simulator precisely, is randomization unnecessary?
Да: точной модели достаточно: Yes: an exact model is enough
Нет: всего не измерить — люфт, износ, за: No: you can't measure everything, since backlash, wear and latencies change and the robot ages over time; in practice, an exact model and randomization are used together
Нет: рандомизация нужна только для карти: No: randomization is needed only for the camera image
Hwangbo и соавторы пишут, что на практик: Hwangbo et al. write that in practice, both approaches are used together: ANYmal has a learned actuator model and 30 inertia variants. Tan et al. set the ranges around the measured values with a small margin.
Политика без рандомизации точнее выучила: The policy without randomization learned its world more precisely. Does that make it more reliable on the robot?
Нет: она подстроилась под особенности од: No: it adapted to the quirks of one world; on Ada's six real arms, it has 78% successful attempts versus 99% for the randomized one with the same budget
Да, если обучать её дольше: Yes, if you train it longer
У Peng и соавторов политика без рандомиз: For Peng et al., the policy without randomization failed in all 10 attempts on the real arm, and the policy with randomization succeeded in 67–89%.
Что сильнее собьёт политику руки Ады из: What throws off the policy of Ada's arm from the exact simulator more: a mug four times heavier or 40 ms of command latency?
Кружка: масса меняет всю динамику руки: The mug: mass changes all of the arm's dynamics
Задержка: она нарушает обратную связь —: The latency: it breaks the feedback loop, and the policy corrects an error that is no longer there
Кружку 1 кг политика удерживала в 20 поп: The policy held the 1 kg mug in 20 attempts out of 20, and with 40 ms of latency, in 9. The policy sees the sag caused by the mass and compensates for it. For Peng et al., without the random time between actions, success on the robot fell from 89 to 29%.
Чем шире диапазоны рандомизации, тем луч: The wider the randomization ranges, the better the transfer?
Да: настоящий мир точно окажется внутри: Yes: the real world will surely be inside
Нет: лишняя ширина делает политику остор: No: excess width makes the policy more cautious and slower and requires more training
Нет: широкие диапазоны всегда портят пер: No: wide ranges always spoil transfer
При ×3 Ада шла к цели 0,88 с против 0,72: At ×3, Ada took 0.88 s to reach the target versus 0.72 s at ×1, with no more successful attempts. Tan et al.: “dynamics randomization trades optimality for robustness.” In Dactyl, the full randomization cost 100 years of experience versus 3 years without it.
Можно ли рандомизацией параметров закрыт: Can randomizing parameters close any gap with the robot?
Да, если менять достаточно параметров: Yes, if you vary enough parameters
Нет: если симулятор устроен иначе, чем р: No: if the simulator is built differently from the robot, for example, if it doesn't model the actuator or the latency, the real world isn't among the variants
Нет: она закрывает только разрыв по карт: No: it closes only the gap in the image
У Tan и соавторов без модели мотора или: For Tan et al., without the motor model or without latency, the Minitaur policies didn't work on the robot; for Hwangbo et al., the policy with an ideal actuator couldn't make a single step.
ADR расширяет диапазоны, пока не упрётся: Does ADR widen the ranges until it hits the end of the scale?
Нет: граница сдвигается наружу, только е: No: a boundary moves outward only if the policy performs at least as well as the upper threshold there, and moves back if it does worse than the lower one
Нет, ADR только сужает диапазоны: No, ADR only narrows the ranges
На руке Ады диапазон задержки ушёл до 75: On Ada's arm, the latency range went out to 75 ms, while motor strength stopped at 63%: with weak motors and a heavy mug, there isn't enough torque, and boundary attempts there don't pass the threshold.
Знает ли рандомизированная политика без: Does a randomized policy without memory know which world it is in?
Да: она видела все миры при обучении: Yes: it saw all the worlds during training
Нет: она выбирает одно поведение, приемл: No: it picks one behavior that is acceptable in all worlds, which is why it is cautious
Да, по первому же наблюдению: Yes, from the very first observation
Понять мир можно только по истории: как: The world can be inferred only from history: how the arm responded to past commands. For Peng et al., the network with memory succeeded on the robot in 89% of attempts versus 67% for the network without memory, and at OpenAI, the cube size was predicted from the LSTM's memory with over 80% accuracy. More on this in lesson 5.5.
Зачем ADR начинает с одного калиброванно: Why does ADR start from a single calibrated world rather than with wide ranges right away?
Это учебный план: в простом мире политик: It's a curriculum: in a simple world, the policy learns quickly, and the hard worlds are added when it's ready for them
На руке Ады ADR дошёл до 90% на настоящи: On Ada's arm, ADR reached 90% on the real arms by step 4,800, and the wide range from the first step by step 10,800. At OpenAI, the wider the fixed randomization, the longer the policy took to train from scratch.
